_scale_note: Design decision, not a canon figure. Chamber of Secrets gives 'fifty feet', which no source converts to Minecraft blocks. The rig (tools/basilisk_model.py) is 9.6 blocks nose to tail at scale 1.0 and 1.95 tall with the head raised; scale 1.4 takes it to about 13.4 blocks long and 2.7 tall, which dwarfs a player without making the square hitbox impassable. A vanilla hitbox is square in plan, so the body lying outside it is drawn, culled and bitten from by BasiliskEntity rather than collided with. Scale raises hitbox and reach together via Attributes.SCALE.
